annotations.title: Check a U.S. contractor against SAM.gov Exclusions

description:
Live check of a company against the SAM.gov Exclusions list (debarred, suspended or otherwise ineligible firms) by 12-character SAM UEI, 5-character CAGE code, or firm name (substring). Returns whether an active exclusion exists, each matching record's exclusion type, program, excluding agency, active and termination dates, and city/state, with the time SAM.gov was checked and a link to verify. Firms only.
FREE tier: 10 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.
